title: Extending the FLI AI Safety Index to a 'broken-promise' tracking dimension

original_idea.body: Extending the FLI AI Safety Index to a 'broken-promise' tracking dimension

theory_of_impact.reasoning: Commitment-integrity tracking supports accountability but the chain to catastrophic-risk reduction has a gap.

accessible_complexity.reasoning: Curated commitments + two-time-point coding with a fixed rubric; beginner-accessible.

narrow_scope.reasoning: Tightly scoped commitment-integrity sub-score with explicit rubric.

counterfactual_value.reasoning: Public-text drift tracker labs won't self-produce; no lab access.

novelty.reasoning: Commitment tracking exists; a structured broken-promise sub-score may be open.

novelty_assessment.reasoning: Commitment tracking exists; structured drift sub-score may be open.
